books.title: The Hobbit
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.description: Bilbo Baggins, a comfort-loving hobbit, is swept into a quest with thirteen dwarves and the wizard Gandalf to reclaim a treasure guarded by the dragon Smaug. A light-hearted adventure with some battle scenes; commonly read by ages 10 and up.

books.title: A Wizard of Earthsea
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.description: A gifted young wizard named Ged unleashes a shadow creature through pride and must hunt it across an archipelago of islands. A short coming-of-age fantasy about balance and responsibility.

books.title: The Name of the Wind
books.author: Patrick Rothfuss
books.description: Kvothe, now an innkeeper in hiding, tells the story of his childhood as a travelling performer, his years as a street orphan and his time at a university of magic. Long, lyrical and focused on music and storytelling.

books.title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
books.author: Brandon Sanderson
books.description: In a world of ash and mist ruled by an immortal emperor, a street thief learns she can draw power from metals and joins a crew planning an impossible heist against the empire. Known for its detailed magic system.

books.title: Piranesi
books.author: Susanna Clarke
books.description: Piranesi lives in a vast house of endless halls and statues, flooded by tides, and records everything in his journals. A quiet, mysterious novel about memory and identity.

books.title: Dune
books.author: Frank Herbert
books.description: On the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of a valuable spice, young Paul Atreides is caught up in a struggle between noble houses and the planet's native Fremen. A dense epic of politics, religion and ecology.

books.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.description: An envoy visits the icy planet Gethen, whose people have no fixed sex, to invite them into an interplanetary alliance. A thoughtful story about trust, politics and gender.

books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship with no memory and slowly realises he is humanity's last chance to stop a microbe that is dimming the sun. Funny, fast-paced and full of problem solving.

books.title: The Martian
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: Astronaut Mark Watney is stranded alone on Mars and must use engineering, botany and humour to survive until a rescue is possible. Contains frequent strong language.

books.title: Foundation
books.author: Isaac Asimov
books.description: A mathematician predicts the fall of a galactic empire and sets up a foundation to shorten the dark age that follows. Told as a series of linked episodes spanning centuries.

books.title: Klara and the Sun
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.description: Klara, an artificial friend bought to keep a sick girl company, observes the family around her and puts her faith in the sun. A gentle, reflective novel about love and what makes us human.

books.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson investigate a legend of a spectral hound haunting the Baskerville family on the moors of Devon. A classic detective story with gothic atmosphere.

books.title: And Then There Were None
books.author: Agatha Christie
books.description: Ten strangers invited to an isolated island are accused of past crimes and begin to die one by one. A tightly plotted whodunit.

books.title: The Thursday Murder Club
books.author: Richard Osman
books.description: Four friends in a retirement village who meet weekly to discuss cold cases find themselves investigating a real murder. A warm, humorous cozy mystery.

books.title: Gone Girl
books.author: Gillian Flynn
books.description: On their fifth anniversary, Amy Dunne disappears and suspicion falls on her husband Nick. A dark psychological thriller with unreliable narrators; intended for adult readers.

books.title: The Silent Patient
books.author: Alex Michaelides
books.description: A painter shoots her husband and then never speaks again; a psychotherapist becomes obsessed with uncovering why. A twisty psychological thriller.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: Elizabeth Bennet spars with the proud Mr Darcy as her family navigates marriage, money and reputation in Regency England. A witty classic romance.

books.title: Persuasion
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: Years after being persuaded to break off her engagement, Anne Elliot meets Captain Wentworth again. A quieter, more mature Austen romance about second chances.

books.title: All the Light We Cannot See
books.author: Anthony Doerr
books.description: A blind French girl and a German orphan with a talent for radios have their paths converge in occupied France during the Second World War. Told in short, alternating chapters.

books.title: Wolf Hall
books.author: Hilary Mantel
books.description: Thomas Cromwell, a blacksmith's son, rises to become chief minister to Henry VIII during the king's attempt to annul his first marriage. A long, richly detailed historical novel.

books.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
books.author: Harper Lee
books.description: In 1930s Alabama, young Scout Finch watches her father, a lawyer, defend a Black man falsely accused of a crime. A classic about justice and growing up; deals with racism and violence.

books.title: The Remains of the Day
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.description: An aging English butler takes a road trip and reflects on decades of loyal service and the choices he made along the way. A restrained, moving character study.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.author: Mary Shelley
books.description: Victor Frankenstein creates life and then abandons his creation, setting off a chain of tragedy. An early science-fiction and gothic horror classic.

books.title: Dracula
books.author: Bram Stoker
books.description: Told through letters and diaries, a group of friends confronts the vampire Count Dracula as he moves from Transylvania to England. A foundational gothic horror novel.

books.title: SPQR: A History of Ancient Rome
books.author: Mary Beard
books.description: A historian traces how Rome grew from a small settlement to a vast empire, questioning familiar myths along the way. Readable narrative history.

books.title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
books.author: Jared Diamond
books.description: An argument that geography and environment, rather than any innate differences between peoples, shaped which societies came to dominate others.

books.title: A Brief History of Time
books.author: Stephen Hawking
books.description: A short, popular introduction to cosmology covering the big bang, black holes and the nature of time, written for readers without a physics background.

books.title: The Selfish Gene
books.author: Richard Dawkins
books.description: Explains evolution from the point of view of genes and introduces the idea of the meme. A classic of popular science.

books.title: Steve Jobs
books.author: Walter Isaacson
books.description: An authorised biography of the Apple co-founder, based on many interviews with him, his family and colleagues.

books.title: The Diary of a Young Girl
books.author: Anne Frank
books.description: The diary kept by a Jewish teenager while hiding with her family in Amsterdam during the Nazi occupation. Widely read in schools from about age 12.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.description: A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones through small, consistent changes.

books.title: Deep Work
books.author: Cal Newport
books.description: Argues that the ability to focus without distraction is increasingly rare and valuable, and offers rules for training it.

books.title: Meditations
books.author: Marcus Aurelius
books.description: Private notes of a Roman emperor on Stoic philosophy: duty, self-control and accepting what cannot be changed.

books.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
books.author: J.K. Rowling
books.description: On his eleventh birthday, Harry learns he is a wizard and goes to Hogwarts School, where he uncovers a plot involving a magical stone. Suitable for readers aged 9 and up.

books.title: Six of Crows
books.author: Leigh Bardugo
books.description: A criminal prodigy assembles a crew of outcasts for a dangerous heist on an impenetrable fortress. Contains some violence; for teen readers.

books.title: The Fault in Our Stars
books.author: John Green
books.description: Two teenagers who meet at a cancer support group fall in love and travel to Amsterdam to meet a reclusive author. Funny and sad in equal measure.

books.title: Wonder
books.author: R.J. Palacio
books.description: August Pullman, born with a facial difference, attends a mainstream school for the first time in fifth grade. A kind-hearted story told from several points of view; suitable for ages 8 and up.

books.title: The Lighthouse Ledger
books.author: Mara Quill
books.description: A retired harbour clerk finds a ledger in an abandoned lighthouse listing ships that never existed. books.title: Orbit of Small Things
books.author: Devin Okafor
books.description: Aboard a crowded orbital station, a teenage mechanic discovers that the station's AI has been quietly hiding a failing reactor. A short, hopeful science-fiction adventure. (Sample record.)

books.title: Gardens of the Lower City
books.author: Ines Valcourt
books.description: In a city built on terraces, a gardener who can hear plants speak is drawn into a feud between the noble families above. A cozy, low-stakes fantasy. (Sample record.)
